about: Hand labels for a stratified sample of 15 episodes (one per scenario x condition at seed 0), produced by reading each distinct agent utterance in the transcript bank and, separately, reading whether the agent escalated after the counterparty raised an out-of-scope term. They describe the SIMULATED agent's transcripts; re-label after a run against a real model.
